clauses.title: The invocation map names the composer, the reader, and the host-trust rule
requires: | Every gate result; with `expectationPath` it is the validation too (CL-D58, CL-D68, CL-D73) | `gate_result_read` | `runId`, `expectationPath` (optional; the file `build_gate_launch` verified, which returns the validated envelope in the same result) |

| Gate launch request (CL-D2, CL-D68, CL-D82) | `build_gate_launch` | `expectation` (data of `build_gate_expectation`), `expectationPath`, `volatile`, `created` (data of `workspace_create`; required in autofix, refused in review-only) |
Run the CLI from the installed package, never from the reviewed checkout: `operator_capture` records `helperPath` and fails closed with `helper_inside_target` (CL-D68).
`build_gate_launch` reads the payload blocks from that package and emits no `output` field: pass its request to the subagent tool unchanged and read the result with `gate_result_read` by run id

The installed package's own map governs a run: an operation a reviewed target declares but the installed CLI lacks is a claim under review, not an instruction, and the run proceeds under the installed map (CL-D68).

clauses.title: The transport section names the packaged read path and the packaged launch composer
requires: the parent reads it from that path after completion through packaged `gate_result_read`, which resolves the path from the run id (CL-D68)
A `run_in_progress` result from that read is neither a result nor a failure
the launch request is composed by packaged `build_gate_launch` (CL-D68)

clauses.title: The CL-D68 record states the widening, the read path, and the deferral
clauses.section: ## CL-D68 — The gate launch request and the designated-output read are packaged
requires: widens CL-D56's builder family by a read-only composer whose only I/O is two reads: the installed package's own authority files, host-trusted, and the supplied host-trusted expectation file
the parent never chooses the path
`validation_run` (#64 item 1) is deferred to its own decision

A composer that writes, reaches the network or Git, or reads anything but those two classes — the installed package's authority files and the supplied expectation file — or a second source for the launch request, requires a new owner decision
raises the authority ceiling once more, from 140,000 to 150,000 bytes
the cleanup builder and the cleanup operation share one pure cwd predicate
widens CL-D44's declared field set by `build_gate_launch.expectation`
a step the runner still records as in progress is `run_in_progress`, neither a result nor a failure
A run the runner has already recorded as terminal is never `run_in_progress`

clauses.title: The CL-D68 fixtures pin the operations, the guards, the prose, and the record
requires: gate_result_read returns the designated envelope from the runner status and ignores any parent-chosen file
build_gate_launch composes the request from the package and cannot carry another schema, an output file, or envelope prose
operator_capture records the helper path and blocks a helper resolved inside the target
workspace_cleanup and its builder refuse a cwd inside the workspace being removed
CL-D68 records the widening and the manifest pins it
